material.description: The UN page describes possible functions in the context of engagement with the United Nations. These examples do not establish that every civil-society organisation performs these functions or has equivalent legal powers in every jurisdiction.
material.locator: UN DGC Civil Society Unit, “Who We Are”: paragraph describing services and humanitarian functions, bringing citizens' concerns to governments, policy monitoring, political participation, analysis and expertise, early-warning functions, and monitoring/implementation of international agreements.
